About_&_Key_Points:
About
Sportking India Limited, a part of the Sportking Group, is a textile manufacturing company engaged in the production of Yarns (Cotton Yarn, Synthetic Yarn, Blended Yarn), fabrics and garments.

Business Profile

Sportking India is a vertically focused yarn manufacturer with a strong export orientation. The company primarily manufactures cotton, blended, acrylic, polyester-cotton and fancy yarns, supplying to domestic and global textile and garment brands.
